+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const ModeDetail = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { id } = useParams&lt;{ id: string }&gt;();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const navigate = useNavigate();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { data: mode, isLoading, error } = useModeById(id || "");</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Handle loading into editor</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleLoad = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigate(`/?mode=${mode.id}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Handle editing</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleEdit = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigate(`/?mode=${mode.id}&amp;edit=true`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Loading state</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (isLoading) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 space-y-8"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;Skeleton className="h-10 w-32" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div className="space-y-4"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-12 w-3/4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-32 w-full" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex gap-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-6 w-24" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-6 w-24" /&gt;</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Error state</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (error || !mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;AlertCircle className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 text-destructive" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2"&gt;Mode Not Found&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;p className="text-muted-foreground mb-6"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The requested mode could not be found"}</span>
+        &lt;/p&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;Button onClick={() =&gt; navigate("/library")} variant="outline"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+          Back to Library
+        &lt;/Button&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 space-y-8"&gt;</span>
+      {/* Back button */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;Button</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        variant="ghost"</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onClick={() =&gt; navigate("/library")}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        className="mb-4"</span>
+      &gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+        Back to Library
+      &lt;/Button&gt;
+&nbsp;

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;motion.div</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        className="space-y-4"</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;h1 className="text-4xl font-bold bg-gradient-primary bg-clip-text text-transparent mb-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              {mode.name}</span>
+            &lt;/h1&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground"&gt;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Heart className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Download className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>

+ * CloudModeService - Interface-first service for cloud mode operations
+ *
+ * This service handles all CRUD operations and engagement features for cloud-stored
+ * MIDI controller modes. Uses dependency injection for the Supabase client.
+ *
+ * @module services/cloud-mode-service
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
+import type { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// Type Definitions
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Pagination options for browsing modes
+ */
+export interface PaginationOptions {
+  page?: number;
+  limit?: number;
+  sort?: 'recent' | 'downloads' | 'likes' | 'rating';
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Filter options for browsing modes
+ */
+export interface ModeFilters extends PaginationOptions {
+  category?: string;
+  tags?: string[];
+  authorId?: string;
+  isPublic?: boolean;
+  isFeatured?: boolean;
+  search?: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Cloud-stored mode with full metadata
+ */
+export interface CloudMode extends CustomMode {
+  // Unique identification
+  id: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Ownership
+  authorId: string;
+  author?: {
+    id: string;
+    email: string;
+    displayName: string;
+    avatarUrl?: string;
+  };
+&nbsp;
+  // Visibility
+  isPublic: boolean;
+  isOfficial: boolean;
+  isFeatured: boolean;
+&nbsp;
+  // Engagement (denormalized)
+  downloads: number;
+  likes: number;
+  views: number;
+  rating: number;
+  ratingCount: number;
+  forkCount: number;
+&nbsp;
+  // Discovery
+  tags: string[];
+  category?: string;
+  thumbnail?: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Relationships
+  parentModeId?: string;
+  parentMode?: CloudMode;
+&nbsp;
+  // Timestamps
+  publishedAt?: string;
+  updatedAt: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Client-side computed
+  userLiked?: boolean;
+  userRating?: number;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Paginated response wrapper
+ */
+export interface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; {
+  data: T[];
+  pagination: {
+    page: number;
+    limit: number;
+    total: number;
+    totalPages: number;
+    hasNext: boolean;
+    hasPrev: boolean;
+  };
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Database row type (snake_case from PostgreSQL)
+ */
+interface ModeRow {
+  id: string;
+  author_id: string;
+  name: string;
+  description: string | null;
+  version: string;
+  controls: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+  is_public: boolean;
+  is_official: boolean;
+  is_featured: boolean;
+  downloads: number;
+  likes: number;
+  views: number;
+  fork_count: number;
+  rating: number | null;
+  rating_count: number;
+  tags: string[];
+  category: string | null;
+  thumbnail: string | null;
+  parent_mode_id: string | null;
+  created_at: string;
+  modified_at: string;
+  published_at: string | null;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**

+interface ModeInsert {
+  id?: string;
+  author_id: string;
+  name: string;
+  description?: string | null;

+  controls: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+  is_public?: boolean;

+  is_featured?: boolean;

+}
+&nbsp;
+/**

+ */
+interface ModeUpdate {
+  name?: string;
+  description?: string | null;

+  controls?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;

+  category?: string | null;
+  thumbnail?: string | null;
+}
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// Service Interface
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Interface for cloud mode operations
+ */
+export interface ICloudModeService {
+  /**
+   * Save a custom mode to the cloud
+   */
+  saveMode(mode: CustomMode): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get all modes for the current user
+   */
+  getMyModes(): Promise&lt;CloudMode[]&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get a specific mode by ID
+   */
+  getModeById(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode | null&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Update an existing mode
+   */
+  updateMode(id: string, updates: Partial&lt;CloudMode&gt;): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Delete a mode
+   */
+  deleteMode(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Publish a mode (make it public)
+   */
+  publishMode(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Unpublish a mode (make it private)
+   */
+  unpublishMode(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get public modes with pagination and filters
+   */
+  getPublicModes(options: ModeFilters): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;CloudMode&gt;&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Like a mode (toggle)
+   */
+  likeMode(modeId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Unlike a mode (toggle)
+   */
+  unlikeMode(modeId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Rate a mode with optional review
+   */
+  rateMode(modeId: string, rating: number, review?: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+}

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  constructor(supabase: SupabaseClient) {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Get public modes with pagination and filters
+   *
+   * @param options - Filter and pagination options
+   * @returns Paginated response with cloud modes
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async getPublicModes(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    options: ModeFilters = {}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;CloudMode&gt;&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { page = 1, limit = 20, sort = 'recent', showLikedOnly } = options;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let query = this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .from('modes')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .select('*', { count: 'exact' })</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .eq('is_public', true);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Apply sorting</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    switch (sort) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'downloads':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('downloads', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'likes':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('likes', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'rating':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('rating', { ascending: false, nullsLast: true });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'recent':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      default:</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('created_at', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Apply pagination</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const from = (page - 1) * limit;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const to = from + limit - 1;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    query = query.range(from, to);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data: modesData, error, count } = await query;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch public modes: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const total = count || 0;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Fetch unique author profiles for all modes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const authorIds = [...new Set((modesData || []).map(mode =&gt; mode.author_id))];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data: profilesData } = await this.supabase</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" ></span></span></span>
+ * UserProfileService - Interface-first service for user profile operations
+ *
+ * This service handles user profile management including screen name selection
+ * and updates. Uses dependency injection for the Supabase client.
+ *
+ * @module services/user-profile-service
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// Type Definitions
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * User profile data
+ */
+export interface UserProfile {
+  id: string;
+  screenName: string;
+  avatarUrl?: string;
+  bio?: string;
+  createdAt: string;
+  modifiedAt: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Database row type (snake_case from PostgreSQL)
+ */
+interface UserProfileRow {
+  id: string;
+  screen_name: string;
+  avatar_url: string | null;
+  bio: string | null;
+  created_at: string;
+  updated_at: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// Service Interface
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Interface for user profile operations
+ */
+export interface IUserProfileService {
+  /**
+   * Get the current user's profile
+   */
+  getUserProfile(): Promise&lt;UserProfile&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Generate multiple screen name options
+   *
+   * @param count Number of options to generate (default: 10)
+   * @returns Array of available screen names
+   */
+  generateScreenNameOptions(count?: number): Promise&lt;string[]&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Update the user's screen name
+   *
+   * @param newScreenName The new screen name to set
+   * @throws Error if screen name is already taken
+   */
+  updateScreenName(newScreenName: string): Promise&lt;UserProfile&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Validate that a screen name is available
+   *
+   * @param screenName Screen name to validate
+   * @returns true if available, false if taken
+   */
+  validateScreenNameAvailable(screenName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt;;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// Service Implementation</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * UserProfileService implementation using Supabase
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export class UserProfileService implements IUserProfileService {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Supabase client injected via constructor
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private readonly supabase: SupabaseClient;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Create a new UserProfileService
+   *
+   * @param supabase - Supabase client instance
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  constructor(supabase: SupabaseClient) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.supabase = supabase;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Get current user ID from session
+   *
+   * @returns User ID
+   * @throws Error if user is not authenticated
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private async getCurrentUserId(): Promise&lt;string&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      data: { user },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      error,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } = await this.supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error || !user) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('User not authenticated. Please sign in to access profile.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return user.id;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Convert database row to UserProfile
+   *
+   * @param row - Database row from Supabase
+   * @returns UserProfile object
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private toUserProfile(row: UserProfileRow): UserProfile {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id: row.id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      screenName: row.screen_name,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      avatarUrl: row.avatar_url || undefined,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      bio: row.bio || undefined,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      createdAt: row.created_at,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      modifiedAt: row.updated_at,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Get the current user's profile
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async getUserProfile(): Promise&lt;UserProfile&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const userId = await this.getCurrentUserId();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data, error } = await this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .from('user_profiles')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .select('*')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .eq('id', userId)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .single();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch user profile: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!data) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('User profile not found. Profile should exist for authenticated users.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return this.toUserProfile(data as UserProfileRow);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Generate multiple screen name options
+   *
+   * @param count Number of options to generate (default: 10)
+   * @returns Array of available screen names
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async generateScreenNameOptions(count: number = 10): Promise&lt;string[]&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data, error } = await this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .rpc('generate_screen_name_batch', { count });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to generate screen name options: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!data || data.length === 0) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Failed to generate screen name options. Please try again.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return data.map((row: { screen_name: string }) =&gt; row.screen_name);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Update the user's screen name
+   *
+   * @param newScreenName The new screen name to set
+   * @throws Error if screen name is already taken
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async updateScreenName(newScreenName: string): Promise&lt;UserProfile&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const userId = await this.getCurrentUserId();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Validate screen name is available</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const isAvailable = await this.validateScreenNameAvailable(newScreenName);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!isAvailable) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Screen name "${newScreenName}" is already taken. Please choose another.`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data, error } = await this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .from('user_profiles')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .update({ screen_name: newScreenName })</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .eq('id', userId)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .select()</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .single();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to update screen name: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!data) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Failed to update screen name. No data returned from database.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return this.toUserProfile(data as UserProfileRow);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Validate that a screen name is available
+   *
+   * @param screenName Screen name to validate
+   * @returns true if available, false if taken
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async validateScreenNameAvailable(screenName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data, error } = await this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .rpc('validate_screen_name_available', { name: screenName });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to validate screen name: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return data === true;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// Factory Function</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Create a UserProfileService instance
+ *
+ * @param supabase - Supabase client instance
+ * @returns UserProfileService instance
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function createUserProfileService(supabase: SupabaseClient): IUserProfileService {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return new UserProfileService(supabase);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-no">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import type { ControlMapping } from '@/types/mode';
+&nbsp;
+export interface ControlInfo {
+  id: string;
+  cc: number;
+  type: 'knob' | 'fader' | 'button';
+  defaultLabel: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Parse control ID and return control information
+ * Supports formats: "knob-cc13", "fader-cc5", "button-cc37"
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function getControlInfo(controlId: string): ControlInfo | null {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const match = controlId.match(/^(knob|fader|button)-cc(\d+)$/);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!match) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return null;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [, type, ccStr] = match;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const cc = parseInt(ccStr, 10);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (isNaN(cc) || cc &lt; 0 || cc &gt; 127) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return null;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Validate CC numbers are in expected ranges</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const validType = type as 'knob' | 'fader' | 'button';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!isValidCCForType(cc, validType)) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return null;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    id: controlId,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    cc,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    type: validType,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    defaultLabel: `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${cc}`</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Validate that CC number is in the expected range for control type
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function isValidCCForType(cc: number, type: 'knob' | 'fader' | 'button'): boolean {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  switch (type) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case 'knob':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Knobs: CC 13-20, 53, 22-36</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return (cc &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; cc &lt;= 20) || cc === 53 || (cc &gt;= 22 &amp;&amp; cc &lt;= 36);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case 'fader':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Faders: CC 5-12</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return cc &gt;= 5 &amp;&amp; cc &lt;= 12;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case 'button':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Buttons: CC 37-52</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return cc &gt;= 37 &amp;&amp; cc &lt;= 52;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    default:</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return false;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Get all 48 control definitions
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function getAllControls(): ControlInfo[] {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const controls: ControlInfo[] = [];</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Knobs: CC 13-20, 53, 22-36 (24 total)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  for (let cc = 13; cc &lt;= 20; cc++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    controls.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id: `knob-cc${cc}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      cc,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: 'knob',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      defaultLabel: `Knob ${cc}`</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // CC 53 knob</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  controls.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    id: 'knob-cc53',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    cc: 53,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    type: 'knob',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    defaultLabel: 'Knob 53'</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  for (let cc = 22; cc &lt;= 36; cc++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    controls.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id: `knob-cc${cc}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      cc,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: 'knob',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      defaultLabel: `Knob ${cc}`</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Faders: CC 5-12 (8 total)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  for (let cc = 5; cc &lt;= 12; cc++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    controls.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id: `fader-cc${cc}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      cc,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: 'fader',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      defaultLabel: `Fader ${cc}`</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Buttons: CC 37-52 (16 total)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  for (let cc = 37; cc &lt;= 52; cc++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    controls.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id: `button-cc${cc}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      cc,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: 'button',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      defaultLabel: `Button ${cc}`</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-no">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >/**</span></span></span>
+ * File storage utilities for custom modes
+ * Supports both File System Access API and fallback methods
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+interface FileHandle {
+  createWritable(): Promise&lt;WritableStream&gt;;
+}
+&nbsp;
+interface SaveFilePickerOptions {
+  suggestedName?: string;
+  types?: Array&lt;{
+    description: string;
+    accept: Record&lt;string, string[]&gt;;
+  }&gt;;
+}
+&nbsp;
+interface OpenFilePickerOptions {
+  types?: Array&lt;{
+    description: string;
+    accept: Record&lt;string, string[]&gt;;
+  }&gt;;
+  multiple?: boolean;
+}
+&nbsp;
+declare global {
+  interface Window {
+    showSaveFilePicker?: (options?: SaveFilePickerOptions) =&gt; Promise&lt;FileHandle&gt;;
+    showOpenFilePicker?: (options?: OpenFilePickerOptions) =&gt; Promise&lt;File[]&gt;;
+  }
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Saves a custom mode to a file
+ * Uses File System Access API if available, falls back to download link
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export async function saveMode(mode: any): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!mode?.name) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    throw new Error('Mode must have a name property');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const filename = `${mode.name}.lcxl3mode.json`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const jsonData = JSON.stringify(mode, null, 2);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Try File System Access API first</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (window.showSaveFilePicker) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const fileHandle = await window.showSaveFilePicker({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        suggestedName: filename,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        types: [</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: 'Launch Control XL3 Mode files',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            accept: {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              'application/json': ['.lcxl3mode.json'],</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          },</span>
+        ],
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await writable.write(jsonData);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await writable.close();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // User cancelled or API failed</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.name === 'AbortError') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error('File save cancelled');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('File System Access API failed, using fallback:', error);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Fallback: Create download link</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const blob = new Blob([jsonData], { type: 'application/json' });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const link = document.createElement('a');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  link.href = url;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  link.download = filename;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  link.style.display = 'none';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  document.body.appendChild(link);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  link.click();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  document.body.removeChild(link);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Clean up object URL</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  setTimeout(() =&gt; URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 100);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Loads a custom mode from a file
+ * Uses File System Access API if available, falls back to file input
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export async function loadMode(): Promise&lt;any&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Try File System Access API first</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (window.showOpenFilePicker) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const [fileHandle] = await window.showOpenFilePicker({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        types: [</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: 'Launch Control XL3 Mode files',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            accept: {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              'application/json': ['.lcxl3mode.json', '.json'],</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ],</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        multiple: false,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const file = await fileHandle.getFile();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const text = await file.text();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const mode = JSON.parse(text);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      validateMode(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return mode;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // User cancelled or API failed, fall through to fallback</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.name === 'AbortError') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error('File selection cancelled');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('File System Access API failed, using fallback:', error);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Fallback: Create file input element</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const input = document.createElement('input');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.type = 'file';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.accept = '.lcxl3mode.json,.json';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.style.display = 'none';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.onchange = async () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const file = input.files?.[0];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (!file) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          reject(new Error('No file selected'));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          return;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const text = await file.text();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const mode = JSON.parse(text);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        validateMode(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        resolve(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        reject(error);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } finally {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        document.body.removeChild(input);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.oncancel = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      document.body.removeChild(input);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      reject(new Error('File selection cancelled'));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    document.body.appendChild(input);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    input.click();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Validates that a loaded object is a valid custom mode
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function validateMode(mode: any): void {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!mode || typeof mode !== 'object') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    throw new Error('Invalid mode file: not a valid JSON object');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!mode.name || typeof mode.name !== 'string') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    throw new Error('Invalid mode file: missing or invalid name field');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!mode.controls || typeof mode.controls !== 'object') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    throw new Error('Invalid mode file: missing or invalid controls field');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Additional validation could be added here for specific control structure</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Checks if File System Access API is supported
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function isFileSystemAccessSupported(): boolean {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return typeof window !== 'undefined' &amp;&amp; 'showSaveFilePicker' in window &amp;&amp; 'showOpenFilePicker' in window;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span></pre></td></tr></table></pre>

+<span class="cline-any cline-yes">1x</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import type { CustomMode, ControlMapping } from '@/types/mode';
+import type {
+  CustomMode as LCXL3CustomMode,
+  ControlMapping as LCXL3Control
+} from '@oletizi/launch-control-xl3';
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Mapping from CC numbers and control types to our control IDs
+ * This matches the actual response format from the LCXL3 library
+ */
+const CC_TO_CONTROL_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+  // Send A knobs (top row) - CC 13-20 (8 knobs)
+  'knob-13': 'knob-cc13',
+  'knob-14': 'knob-cc14',
+  'knob-15': 'knob-cc15',
+  'knob-16': 'knob-cc16',
+  'knob-17': 'knob-cc17',
+  'knob-18': 'knob-cc18',
+  'knob-19': 'knob-cc19',
+  'knob-20': 'knob-cc20',
+&nbsp;
+  // Send B knobs (middle row) - CC 29-36 (8 knobs)
+  'knob-29': 'knob-cc29',
+  'knob-30': 'knob-cc30',
+  'knob-31': 'knob-cc31',
+  'knob-32': 'knob-cc32',
+  'knob-33': 'knob-cc33',
+  'knob-34': 'knob-cc34',
+  'knob-35': 'knob-cc35',
+  'knob-36': 'knob-cc36',
+&nbsp;
+  // Pan/Device knobs (bottom row) - CC 22-28, 53 (8 knobs)
+  'knob-22': 'knob-cc22',
+  'knob-23': 'knob-cc23',
+  'knob-24': 'knob-cc24',
+  'knob-25': 'knob-cc25',
+  'knob-26': 'knob-cc26',
+  'knob-27': 'knob-cc27',
+  'knob-28': 'knob-cc28',
+  'knob-53': 'knob-cc53',
+&nbsp;
+  // Faders - CC 5-12 (8 faders)
+  'fader-5': 'fader-cc5',
+  'fader-6': 'fader-cc6',
+  'fader-7': 'fader-cc7',
+  'fader-8': 'fader-cc8',
+  'fader-9': 'fader-cc9',
+  'fader-10': 'fader-cc10',
+  'fader-11': 'fader-cc11',
+  'fader-12': 'fader-cc12',
+&nbsp;
+  // Track focus buttons - CC 41-48 (8 buttons)
+  'button-41': 'button-cc41',
+  'button-42': 'button-cc42',
+  'button-43': 'button-cc43',
+  'button-44': 'button-cc44',
+  'button-45': 'button-cc45',
+  'button-46': 'button-cc46',
+  'button-47': 'button-cc47',
+  'button-48': 'button-cc48',
+&nbsp;
+  // Track control buttons - CC 37-40, 49-52 (8 buttons)
+  'button-37': 'button-cc37',
+  'button-38': 'button-cc38',
+  'button-39': 'button-cc39',
+  'button-40': 'button-cc40',
+  'button-49': 'button-cc49',
+  'button-50': 'button-cc50',
+  'button-51': 'button-cc51',
+  'button-52': 'button-cc52'
+};
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Correct mapping for LCXL3 library v1.9.0+
+ * Maps library control IDs to our internal control IDs
+ */
+const LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP: Record&lt;number, string&gt; = {
+  // Send A knobs (top row) - CC 13-20 - FIXED IDs 0x10-0x17
+  0x10: 'knob-cc13',
+  0x11: 'knob-cc14',
+  0x12: 'knob-cc15',
+  0x13: 'knob-cc16',
+  0x14: 'knob-cc17',
+  0x15: 'knob-cc18',
+  0x16: 'knob-cc19',
+  0x17: 'knob-cc20',
+&nbsp;
+  // Send B knobs (middle row) - CC 29-36 - FIXED IDs 0x18-0x1F
+  0x18: 'knob-cc29',
+  0x19: 'knob-cc30',
+  0x1A: 'knob-cc31',
+  0x1B: 'knob-cc32',
+  0x1C: 'knob-cc33',
+  0x1D: 'knob-cc34',
+  0x1E: 'knob-cc35',
+  0x1F: 'knob-cc36',
+&nbsp;
+  // Pan/Device knobs (bottom row) - CC 22-28, 53 - FIXED IDs 0x20-0x27
+  0x20: 'knob-cc22',
+  0x21: 'knob-cc23',
+  0x22: 'knob-cc24',
+  0x23: 'knob-cc25',
+  0x24: 'knob-cc26',
+  0x25: 'knob-cc27',
+  0x26: 'knob-cc28',
+  0x27: 'knob-cc53',
+&nbsp;
+  // Faders - CC 5-12 - FIXED IDs 0x28-0x2F
+  0x28: 'fader-cc5',
+  0x29: 'fader-cc6',
+  0x2A: 'fader-cc7',
+  0x2B: 'fader-cc8',
+  0x2C: 'fader-cc9',
+  0x2D: 'fader-cc10',
+  0x2E: 'fader-cc11',
+  0x2F: 'fader-cc12',
+&nbsp;
+  // Track focus buttons - CC 41-48 - FIXED IDs 0x30-0x37
+  0x30: 'button-cc41',
+  0x31: 'button-cc42',
+  0x32: 'button-cc43',
+  0x33: 'button-cc44',
+  0x34: 'button-cc45',
+  0x35: 'button-cc46',
+  0x36: 'button-cc47',
+  0x37: 'button-cc48',
+&nbsp;
+  // Track control buttons - CC 37-40, 49-52 - FIXED IDs 0x38-0x3F
+  0x38: 'button-cc37',
+  0x39: 'button-cc38',
+  0x3A: 'button-cc39',
+  0x3B: 'button-cc40',
+  0x3C: 'button-cc49',
+  0x3D: 'button-cc50',
+  0x3E: 'button-cc51',
+  0x3F: 'button-cc52'
+};
+&nbsp;
+export function lcxl3ModeToCustomMode(lcxl3Mode: LCXL3CustomMode): CustomMode {
+  const controls: Record&lt;string, ControlMapping&gt; = {};
+&nbsp;
+  // Debug logging
+  console.group('=== lcxl3ModeToCustomMode DEBUG ===');
+  console.log('Raw mode from device:', lcxl3Mode);
+  console.log('mode.name:', lcxl3Mode.name);
+  console.log('mode.metadata:', lcxl3Mode.metadata);
+  console.log('metadata?.name:', lcxl3Mode.metadata?.name);
+  console.log('metadata?.description:', lcxl3Mode.metadata?.description);
+  console.log('metadata?.version:', lcxl3Mode.metadata?.version);
+  console.groupEnd();
+&nbsp;
+  if (!lcxl3Mode.controls) {
+    console.warn('No controls found in mode:', lcxl3Mode);
+    return {
+      name: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >name || lcxl3Mode.name<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > </span>|| 'Fetched Mode',</span>
+      description: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >description || `Fetched from device on ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,</span>
+      version: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >version || '1.0.0',</span>
+      controls: {},
+      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+      modifiedAt: new Date().toISOString()
+    };
+  }
+&nbsp;
+  let controlsArray: LCXL3Control[];
+  if (Array.isArray(lcxl3Mode.controls)) {
+    controlsArray = lcxl3Mode.controls;
+  } else if (lcxl3Mode.controls instanceof Map) {
+    controlsArray = Array.from(lcxl3Mode.controls.values());
+  } else if (typeof lcxl3Mode.controls === 'object') {
+    controlsArray = Object.values(lcxl3Mode.controls);
+  } else {
+    console.error('Unknown controls format:', typeof lcxl3Mode.controls, lcxl3Mode.controls);
+    throw new Error(`Invalid controls format: ${typeof lcxl3Mode.controls}`);
+  }
+&nbsp;
+  for (const control of controlsArray) {
+    // Try to determine control ID using different methods
+    let ourControlId: string | null = null;
+&nbsp;
+    // Method 1: Use controlId if available (legacy format)
+    if (control.controlId || control.controlId === 0) {
+      ourControlId = LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP[control.controlId];
+    }
+&nbsp;
+    // Method 2: Use CC number and type (current library format)
+    if (!ourControlId) {
+      const ccNumber = control.ccNumber ?? control.cc;
+      const controlType = control.type ?? control.controlType;
+&nbsp;
+      if (ccNumber !== undefined &amp;&amp; controlType) {
+        const lookupKey = `${controlType}-${ccNumber}`;
+        ourControlId = CC_TO_CONTROL_MAP[lookupKey];
+&nbsp;
+        if (!ourControlId) {
+          console.warn(`No mapping found for ${lookupKey}:`, control);
+        }
+      } else {
+        console.warn(`Control missing type or CC:`, control);
+        continue;
+      }
+    }
+&nbsp;
+    if (!ourControlId) {
+      continue;
+    }
+&nbsp;
+    const ccNumber = control.ccNumber ?? control.cc;
+    const midiChannel = control.midiChannel ?? control.channel<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > ?? 0;</span>
+    const minValue = control.minValue ?? control.min<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > ?? 0;</span>
+    const maxValue = control.maxValue ?? control.max<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > ?? 127;</span>
+&nbsp;
+    if (ccNumber === undefined) <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >{</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn(`Missing CC number for control:`, control);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      continue;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+    const controlType = ourControlId.startsWith('knob-')
+      ? 'knob'
+      : ourControlId.startsWith('fader-')
+        ? 'fader'
+        : 'button';
+&nbsp;
+    controls[ourControlId] = {
+      id: ourControlId,
+      type: controlType,
+      ccNumber,
+      midiChannel,
+      minValue,
+      maxValue,
+      label: control.name<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > || ''</span>
+    };
+  }
+&nbsp;
+  return {
+    name: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.name || lcxl3Mode.name<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" > || 'Fetched Mode',</span>
+    description: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.description || `Fetched from device on ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,
+    version: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.version || '1.0.0',
+    controls,
+    createdAt: lcxl3Mode.metadata?.createdAt instanceof <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Date</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      ? lcxl3Mode.metadata.createdAt.toISOString()</span>
+      : new Date().toISOString(),
+    modifiedAt: new Date().toISOString()
+  };
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Reverse mapping from our control IDs to LCXL3 control hex IDs
+ */
+const APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_MAP: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = Object.fromEntries(
+  Object.entries(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).map(([lcxl3Id, ourId]) =&gt; [ourId, parseInt(lcxl3Id)])
+);
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Mapping from our control IDs to library's named constants
+ * Based on CONTROL_IDS in @oletizi/launch-control-xl3 v1.9.0
+ */
+const APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_NAMES: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+  // Send A knobs - map to SEND_A1-SEND_A8
+  'knob-cc13': 'SEND_A1',
+  'knob-cc14': 'SEND_A2',
+  'knob-cc15': 'SEND_A3',
+  'knob-cc16': 'SEND_A4',
+  'knob-cc17': 'SEND_A5',
+  'knob-cc18': 'SEND_A6',
+  'knob-cc19': 'SEND_A7',
+  'knob-cc20': 'SEND_A8',
+&nbsp;
+  // Send B knobs - map to SEND_B1-SEND_B8
+  'knob-cc29': 'SEND_B1',
+  'knob-cc30': 'SEND_B2',
+  'knob-cc31': 'SEND_B3',
+  'knob-cc32': 'SEND_B4',
+  'knob-cc33': 'SEND_B5',
+  'knob-cc34': 'SEND_B6',
+  'knob-cc35': 'SEND_B7',
+  'knob-cc36': 'SEND_B8',
+&nbsp;
+  // Pan/Device knobs - map to PAN1-PAN8
+  'knob-cc22': 'PAN1',
+  'knob-cc23': 'PAN2',
+  'knob-cc24': 'PAN3',
+  'knob-cc25': 'PAN4',
+  'knob-cc26': 'PAN5',
+  'knob-cc27': 'PAN6',
+  'knob-cc28': 'PAN7',
+  'knob-cc53': 'PAN8',
+&nbsp;
+  // Faders - map to FADER1-FADER8
+  'fader-cc5': 'FADER1',
+  'fader-cc6': 'FADER2',
+  'fader-cc7': 'FADER3',
+  'fader-cc8': 'FADER4',
+  'fader-cc9': 'FADER5',
+  'fader-cc10': 'FADER6',
+  'fader-cc11': 'FADER7',
+  'fader-cc12': 'FADER8',
+&nbsp;
+  // Focus buttons - map to FOCUS1-FOCUS8
+  'button-cc41': 'FOCUS1',
+  'button-cc42': 'FOCUS2',
+  'button-cc43': 'FOCUS3',
+  'button-cc44': 'FOCUS4',
+  'button-cc45': 'FOCUS5',
+  'button-cc46': 'FOCUS6',
+  'button-cc47': 'FOCUS7',
+  'button-cc48': 'FOCUS8',
+&nbsp;
+  // Control buttons - map to CONTROL1-CONTROL8
+  'button-cc37': 'CONTROL1',
+  'button-cc38': 'CONTROL2',
+  'button-cc39': 'CONTROL3',
+  'button-cc40': 'CONTROL4',
+  'button-cc49': 'CONTROL5',
+  'button-cc50': 'CONTROL6',
+  'button-cc51': 'CONTROL7',
+  'button-cc52': 'CONTROL8',
+};
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Convert our CustomMode format to LCXL3 mode format
+ * Uses library's named constants (SEND_A1, FADER1, etc.) as required by v1.9.0+
+ */
+export function customModeToLCXL3Mode(customMode: CustomMode): LCXL3CustomMode {
+  const controls: Record&lt;string, LCXL3Control&gt; = {};
+  const labels = new Map&lt;number, string&gt;();
+&nbsp;
+  // Process each control mapping from our custom mode
+  for (const [ourControlId, control] of Object.entries(customMode.controls)) {
+    const controlName = APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_NAMES[ourControlId];
+    if (!controlName) {
+      console.warn(`No LCXL3 control name found for: ${ourControlId}`);
+      continue;
+    }
+&nbsp;
+    // Use library's expected format with named keys and specific field names
+    controls[controlName] = {
+      controlId: APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_MAP[ourControlId],
+      type: control.type,
+      channel: control.midiChannel,      // Library uses 'channel' not 'midiChannel'
+      cc: control.ccNumber,               // Library uses 'cc' not 'ccNumber'
+      min: control.minValue,              // Library uses 'min' not 'minValue'
+      max: control.maxValue,              // Library uses 'max' not 'maxValue'
+      behaviour: 'absolute',              // Library uses 'behaviour' not 'behavior'
+      name: control.label                 // Add label as 'name' property
+    };
+&nbsp;
+    // Add label to labels map if provided (for compatibility)
+    if (control.label) {
+      labels.set(APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_MAP[ourControlId], control.label);
+    }
+  }
+&nbsp;
+  return {
+    name: customMode.name.substring(0, 18), // LCXL3 names limited to 18 chars (v1.20.18+)
+    controls,
+    labels,
+    metadata: {
+      name: customMode.name,
+      description: customMode.description,
+      version: customMode.version
+    }
+  };
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Get all supported LCXL3 control hex IDs
+ */
+export function getAllLCXL3ControlIds(): number[] {
+  return Object.keys(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).map(hex =&gt; parseInt(hex));
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Get all our control IDs that map to LCXL3 controls
+ */
+export function getAllMappedControlIds(): string[] {
+  return Object.values(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP);
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Check if a control ID is supported for LCXL3 conversion
+ */
+export function isControlIdMapped(controlId: string): boolean {
+  return controlId in APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_MAP;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Get the LCXL3 control hex ID for our control ID
+ */
+export function getLCXL3ControlId(ourControlId: string): number | null {
+  return APP_TO_LCXL3_CONTROL_MAP[ourControlId] ?? null;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Get our control ID for an LCXL3 control hex ID
+ */
+export function getOurControlId(lcxl3ControlId: number): string | null {
+  return LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP[lcxl3ControlId] ?? null;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Get control mapping statistics
+ */
+export function getControlMappingStats() {
+  const totalControls = Object.keys(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).length;
+  const knobControls = Object.values(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).filter(id =&gt; id.startsWith('knob-')).length;
+  const faderControls = Object.values(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).filter(id =&gt; id.startsWith('fader-')).length;
+  const buttonControls = Object.values(LCXL3_TO_APP_CONTROL_MAP).filter(id =&gt; id.startsWith('button-')).length;
+&nbsp;
+  return {
+    total: totalControls,
+    knobs: knobControls,
+    faders: faderControls,
+    buttons: buttonControls,
+    expectedTotal: 48 // 24 knobs + 8 faders + 16 buttons
+  };
+}</pre></td></tr></table></pre>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Simple hash function for mode data
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function hashMode(mode: CustomMode): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Create a stable representation of controls only</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const controlsKeys = Object.keys(mode.controls).sort();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const controlsData = controlsKeys.map(key =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const c = mode.controls[key];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${key}:${c.ccNumber}:${c.midiChannel}:${c.minValue}:${c.maxValue}`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }).join('|');</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Simple hash (not cryptographic, just for comparison)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  let hash = 0;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  for (let i = 0; i &lt; controlsData.length; i++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const char = controlsData.charCodeAt(i);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    hash = ((hash &lt;&lt; 5) - hash) + char;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    hash = hash &amp; hash; // Convert to 32-bit integer</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return hash.toString(36);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Compare two modes for equality (ignoring timestamps/metadata)
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function modesAreEqual(a: CustomMode, b: CustomMode): boolean {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return hashMode(a) === hashMode(b);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Check if edit buffer matches device slot
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export async function checkSlotSync(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  editBuffer: CustomMode,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  deviceMode: LCXL3CustomMode</span>
+): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const convertedDeviceMode = lcxl3ModeToCustomMode(deviceMode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return modesAreEqual(editBuffer, convertedDeviceMode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+export type SyncStatus = 'synced' | 'modified' | 'syncing' | 'unknown';
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Sync tracker that uses optimistic updates
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export class SyncTracker {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private lastKnownDeviceHash: string | null = null;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private lastEditBufferHash: string | null = null;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  markFetched(mode: CustomMode): void {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const hash = hashMode(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.lastKnownDeviceHash = hash;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.lastEditBufferHash = hash;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Mark that we just sent to device
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  markSent(mode: CustomMode): void {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const hash = hashMode(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.lastKnownDeviceHash = hash;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.lastEditBufferHash = hash;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  markEdited(mode: CustomMode): void {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  getOptimisticStatus(): SyncStatus {</span>

diff --git a/coverage/sorter.js b/coverage/sorter.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4ed70ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/coverage/sorter.js
@@ -0,0 +1,210 @@
+/* eslint-disable */
+var addSorting = (function() {
+    'use strict';
+    var cols,
+        currentSort = {
+            index: 0,
+            desc: false
+        };
+
+    // returns the summary table element
+    function getTable() {
+        return document.querySelector('.coverage-summary');
+    }
+    // returns the thead element of the summary table
+    function getTableHeader() {
+        return getTable().querySelector('thead tr');
+    }
+    // returns the tbody element of the summary table
+    function getTableBody() {
+        return getTable().querySelector('tbody');
+    }
+    // returns the th element for nth column
+    function getNthColumn(n) {
+        return getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th')[n];
+    }
+
+    function onFilterInput() {
+        const searchValue = document.getElementById('fileSearch').value;
+        const rows = document.getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0].children;
+
+        // Try to create a RegExp from the searchValue. If it fails (invalid regex),
+        // it will be treated as a plain text search
+        let searchRegex;
+        try {
+            searchRegex = new RegExp(searchValue, 'i'); // 'i' for case-insensitive
+        } catch (error) {
+            searchRegex = null;
+        }
+
+        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
+            const row = rows[i];
+            let isMatch = false;
+
+            if (searchRegex) {
+                // If a valid regex was created, use it for matching
+                isMatch = searchRegex.test(row.textContent);
+            } else {
+                // Otherwise, fall back to the original plain text search
+                isMatch = row.textContent
+                    .toLowerCase()
+                    .includes(searchValue.toLowerCase());
+            }
+
+            row.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // loads the search box
+    function addSearchBox() {
+        var template = document.getElementById('filterTemplate');
+        var templateClone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
+        templateClone.getElementById('fileSearch').oninput = onFilterInput;
+        template.parentElement.appendChild(templateClone);
+    }
+
+    // loads all columns
+    function loadColumns() {
+        var colNodes = getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th'),
+            colNode,
+            cols = [],
+            col,
+            i;
+
+        for (i = 0; i < colNodes.length; i += 1) {
+            colNode = colNodes[i];
+            col = {
+                key: colNode.getAttribute('data-col'),
+                sortable: !colNode.getAttribute('data-nosort'),
+                type: colNode.getAttribute('data-type') || 'string'
+            };
+            cols.push(col);
+            if (col.sortable) {
+                col.defaultDescSort = col.type === 'number';
+                colNode.innerHTML =
+                    colNode.innerHTML + '<span class="sorter"></span>';
+            }
+        }
+        return cols;
+    }
+    // attaches a data attribute to every tr element with an object
+    // of data values keyed by column name
+    function loadRowData(tableRow) {
+        var tableCols = tableRow.querySelectorAll('td'),
+            colNode,
+            col,
+            data = {},
+            i,
+            val;
+        for (i = 0; i < tableCols.length; i += 1) {
+            colNode = tableCols[i];
+            col = cols[i];
+            val = colNode.getAttribute('data-value');
+            if (col.type === 'number') {
+                val = Number(val);
+            }
+            data[col.key] = val;
+        }
+        return data;
+    }
+    // loads all row data
+    function loadData() {
+        var rows = getTableBody().querySelectorAll('tr'),
+            i;
+
+        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
+            rows[i].data = loadRowData(rows[i]);
+        }
+    }
+    // sorts the table using the data for the ith column
+    function sortByIndex(index, desc) {
+        var key = cols[index].key,
+            sorter = function(a, b) {
+                a = a.data[key];
+                b = b.data[key];
+                return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
+            },
+            finalSorter = sorter,
+            tableBody = document.querySelector('.coverage-summary tbody'),
+            rowNodes = tableBody.querySelectorAll('tr'),
+            rows = [],
+            i;
+
+        if (desc) {
+            finalSorter = function(a, b) {
+                return -1 * sorter(a, b);
+            };
+        }
+
+        for (i = 0; i < rowNodes.length; i += 1) {
+            rows.push(rowNodes[i]);
+            tableBody.removeChild(rowNodes[i]);
+        }
+
+        rows.sort(finalSorter);
+
+        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
+            tableBody.appendChild(rows[i]);
+        }
+    }
+    // removes sort indicators for current column being sorted
+    function removeSortIndicators() {
+        var col = getNthColumn(currentSort.index),
+            cls = col.className;
+
+        cls = cls.replace(/ sorted$/, '').replace(/ sorted-desc$/, '');
+        col.className = cls;
+    }
+    // adds sort indicators for current column being sorted
+    function addSortIndicators() {
+        getNthColumn(currentSort.index).className += currentSort.desc
+            ? ' sorted-desc'
+            : ' sorted';
+    }
+    // adds event listeners for all sorter widgets
+    function enableUI() {
+        var i,
+            el,
+            ithSorter = function ithSorter(i) {
+                var col = cols[i];
+
+                return function() {
+                    var desc = col.defaultDescSort;
+
+                    if (currentSort.index === i) {
+                        desc = !currentSort.desc;
+                    }
+                    sortByIndex(i, desc);
+                    removeSortIndicators();
+                    currentSort.index = i;
+                    currentSort.desc = desc;
+                    addSortIndicators();
+                };
+            };
+        for (i = 0; i < cols.length; i += 1) {
+            if (cols[i].sortable) {
+                // add the click event handler on the th so users
+                // dont have to click on those tiny arrows
+                el = getNthColumn(i).querySelector('.sorter').parentElement;
+                if (el.addEventListener) {
+                    el.addEventListener('click', ithSorter(i));
+                } else {
+                    el.attachEvent('onclick', ithSorter(i));
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    // adds sorting functionality to the UI
+    return function() {
+        if (!getTable()) {
+            return;
+        }
+        cols = loadColumns();
+        loadData();
+        addSearchBox();
+        addSortIndicators();
+        enableUI();
+    };
+})();
+
+window.addEventListener('load', addSorting);

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >/**</span></span></span>
+ * ModeCard Component
+ *
+ * A reusable card component for displaying mode information in catalog and library views.
+ * Displays mode metadata, engagement metrics, author information, and provides
+ * action buttons based on user permissions (like, load, edit, delete, share).
+ *
+ * Features:
+ * - Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
+ * - Optimistic like updates
+ * - Conditional action buttons based on authorship
+ * - Loading states for all async actions
+ * - Toast notifications for success/error feedback
+ * - Click card to view details
+ *
+ * @module components/cloud-storage/ModeCard
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import * as React from 'react';

+import {

+  Eye,
+  Star,

+  Loader2,
+} from 'lucide-react';
+&nbsp;
+import { CloudMode } from '@/types/cloud-mode';
+import {
+  useIsLiked,
+  useIsAuthor,
+  useLikeMode,
+  useDeleteMode,
+  usePublishMode,
+  useUnpublishMode,
+} from '@/hooks/use-cloud-modes';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import {
+  formatCategory,
+  formatRating,
+  formatMetric,
+  getInitials,
+  truncateDescription,
+} from '@/components/cloud-storage/mode-card-utils';
+import {
+  Card,
+  CardContent,
+  CardDescription,
+  CardFooter,
+  CardHeader,
+  CardTitle,
+} from '@/components/ui/card';
+import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

+import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
+import {
+  DropdownMenu,

+  DropdownMenuItem,
+  DropdownMenuSeparator,
+  DropdownMenuTrigger,
+} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
