+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// TYPES
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * ModeCard component props
+ */
+export interface ModeCardProps {
+  /** Mode data to display */
+  mode: CloudMode;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Callback when card is clicked to view details */
+  onSelect?: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Callback when load button is clicked */
+  onLoad?: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Callback when edit button is clicked */
+  onEdit?: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;

+  className?: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// COMPONENT</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * ModeCard Component
+ *
+ * Displays mode information with engagement metrics and action buttons.
+ * Supports responsive layouts and optimistic UI updates.
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * &lt;ModeCard
+ *   mode={cloudMode}
+ *   onSelect={(mode) =&gt; navigate(`/modes/${mode.id}`)}
+ *   onLoad={(mode) =&gt; applyModeToController(mode)}
+ *   onEdit={(mode) =&gt; openEditDialog(mode)}
+ * /&gt;
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function ModeCard({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  mode,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onSelect,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onLoad,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onEdit,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  className,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}: ModeCardProps): React.ReactElement {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const isLiked = useIsLiked(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const isAuthor = useIsAuthor(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const likeMutation = useLikeMode();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const deleteMutation = useDeleteMode();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const publishMutation = usePublishMode();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const unpublishMutation = useUnpublishMode();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle like/unlike action
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleLike = (e: React.MouseEvent): void =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent card click</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    likeMutation.mutate(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        modeId: mode.id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        currentlyLiked: isLiked,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onError: (error) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toast.error('Failed to update like', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle load mode action
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleLoad = (e: React.MouseEvent): void =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.stopPropagation();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (onLoad) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onLoad(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast.success('Opening in Editor', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: `${mode.name} is ready to edit.`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle edit mode action
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent): void =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.stopPropagation();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (onEdit) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onEdit(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle delete mode action
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleDelete = (e: React.MouseEvent): void =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.stopPropagation();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const confirmed = confirm(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      `Are you sure you want to delete "${mode.name}"? This action cannot be undone.`</span>
+    );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!confirmed) return;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    deleteMutation.mutate(mode.id, {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onSuccess: () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toast.success('Mode Deleted', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          description: `${mode.name} has been permanently deleted.`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onError: (error) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toast.error('Failed to Delete Mode', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle publish/unpublish toggle
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleTogglePublish = (e: React.MouseEvent): void =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.stopPropagation();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (mode.isPublic) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      unpublishMutation.mutate(mode.id, {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onSuccess: () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toast.success('Mode Unpublished', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: `${mode.name} is now private.`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onError: (error) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toast.error('Failed to Unpublish', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } else {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      publishMutation.mutate(mode.id, {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onSuccess: () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toast.success('Mode Published', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: `${mode.name} is now visible in the public catalog.`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onError: (error) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toast.error('Failed to Publish', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;

+// ============================================================================

+&nbsp;
+export interface ModeFiltersPanelProps {

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * ModeFiltersPanel provides a comprehensive filtering interface for browsing modes.
+ *
+ * Adapts its UI based on the variant prop:

+ * - Catalog: Shows search, category, tags, sort, featured, liked, pagination
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx

+ * &lt;ModeFiltersPanel

+ *   filters={libraryFilters}
+ *   onChange={setLibraryFilters}

+ *
+ * // Catalog usage
+ * &lt;ModeFiltersPanel
+ *   variant="catalog"
+ *   filters={catalogFilters}
+ *   onChange={setCatalogFilters}
+ * /&gt;
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export const ModeFiltersPanel: React.FC&lt;ModeFiltersPanelProps&gt; = ({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  filters,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onChange,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  variant,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  className,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  defaultCollapsed = true,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Local state for search input (debounced)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [searchValue, setSearchValue] = React.useState(filters.search || '');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [tagsValue, setTagsValue] = React.useState(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    'tags' in filters &amp;&amp; filters.tags ? filters.tags.join(', ') : ''</span>
+  );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Debounce timer refs</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const searchTimeoutRef = React.useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const tagsTimeoutRef = React.useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Type guards</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const isCatalogFilters = (f: LibraryFilters | ModeFilters): f is ModeFilters =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return variant === 'catalog';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Sync local search state with prop changes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setSearchValue(filters.search || '');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [filters.search]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Sync local tags state with prop changes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if ('tags' in filters) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setTagsValue(filters.tags?.join(', ') || '');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [filters]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle search input with debouncing
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleSearchChange = (value: string) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setSearchValue(value);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Clear existing timeout</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (searchTimeoutRef.current) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      clearTimeout(searchTimeoutRef.current);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Set new timeout</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    searchTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onChange({</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle tags input with debouncing (catalog only)
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleTagsChange = (value: string) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setTagsValue(value);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Clear existing timeout</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (tagsTimeoutRef.current) {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Set new timeout</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    tagsTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const tags = value</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          page: 1, // Reset to first page</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle category selection (catalog only)
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleCategoryChange = (value: string) =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleSortChange = (value: string) =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >/**</span></span></span>
+ * ModeGrid Component
+ *
+ * A reusable display component for mode lists with comprehensive state handling.
+ * Supports loading skeletons, empty states, error states, and success rendering.
+ *
+ * Features:
+ * - Loading state with skeleton cards
+ * - Error state with Alert component
+ * - Empty state with custom message and icon
+ * - Grid/list view mode support
+ * - Optional pagination controls
+ * - Animated mode cards with stagger effect
+ *
+ * @module components/cloud-storage/ModeGrid
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import * as React from 'react';
+import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
+import { AlertCircle, PackageOpen } from 'lucide-react';
+import { CloudMode } from '@/types/cloud-mode';
+import { ModeCard } from '@/components/cloud-storage/ModeCard';
+import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
+import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
+import {
+  Pagination,
+  PaginationContent,
+  PaginationEllipsis,
+  PaginationItem,
+  PaginationLink,
+  PaginationNext,
+  PaginationPrevious,
+} from '@/components/ui/pagination';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// INTERFACES
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+export interface ModeGridProps {
+  /** Array of modes to display */
+  modes: CloudMode[];
+&nbsp;
+  /** Whether data is currently loading */
+  isLoading: boolean;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Error object if fetch failed */
+  error: Error | null;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Display mode: grid or list */
+  viewMode?: 'grid' | 'list';
+&nbsp;
+  /** Custom message for empty state */
+  emptyMessage?: string;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Custom icon for empty state */
+  emptyIcon?: React.ReactNode;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Callback when mode card is clicked */
+  onModeSelect: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Optional callback when load button is clicked */
+  onModeLoad?: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Optional callback when edit button is clicked */
+  onModeEdit?: (mode: CloudMode) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Whether to show pagination controls */
+  showPagination?: boolean;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Pagination data */
+  pagination?: {
+    page: number;
+    totalPages: number;
+    hasNext: boolean;
+    hasPrev: boolean;
+  };
+&nbsp;
+  /** Callback when page changes */
+  onPageChange?: (page: number) =&gt; void;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Optional CSS class name */
+  className?: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// COMPONENT</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * ModeGrid displays a collection of mode cards with comprehensive state handling.
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * &lt;ModeGrid
+ *   modes={modes}
+ *   isLoading={isLoading}
+ *   error={error}
+ *   viewMode="grid"
+ *   onModeSelect={(mode) =&gt; navigate(`/modes/${mode.id}`)}
+ *   onModeLoad={(mode) =&gt; loadMode(mode)}
+ *   onModeEdit={(mode) =&gt; openEditor(mode)}
+ *   showPagination={true}
+ *   pagination={paginationData}
+ *   onPageChange={handlePageChange}
+ * /&gt;
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export const ModeGrid: React.FC&lt;ModeGridProps&gt; = ({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  modes,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  isLoading,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  error,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  viewMode = 'grid',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  emptyMessage = 'No modes found',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  emptyIcon,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onModeSelect,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onModeLoad,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onModeEdit,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  showPagination = false,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  pagination,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onPageChange,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  className,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Render loading skeletons
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const renderSkeletons = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const skeletonCount = pagination?.limit || 24;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const gridClass = viewMode === 'list'</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4'</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      : 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className={gridClass}&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {Array.from({ length: skeletonCount }).map((_, i) =&gt; (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div key={i} className="space-y-4"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-48 w-full" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" /&gt;</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        ))}
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Render empty state
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const renderEmptyState = () =&gt; (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;motion.div</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 space-y-4"</span>
+    &gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      {emptyIcon || &lt;PackageOpen className="h-24 w-24 text-muted-foreground/50" /&gt;}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;h3 className="text-xl font-semibold"&gt;No Modes Found&lt;/h3&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;p className="text-muted-foreground text-center max-w-md"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {emptyMessage}</span>
+      &lt;/p&gt;
+    &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+  );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Render error state
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const renderErrorState = () =&gt; (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;Alert variant="destructive"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;AlertTitle&gt;Error Loading Modes&lt;/AlertTitle&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;AlertDescription&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load modes.'}</span>
+      &lt;/AlertDescription&gt;
+    &lt;/Alert&gt;
+  );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Calculate page numbers to display in pagination
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const getPageNumbers = (): (number | 'ellipsis')[] =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!pagination) return [];</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { page, totalPages } = pagination;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const pages: (number | 'ellipsis')[] = [];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const showPages = 5; // Max number of page buttons to show</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (totalPages &lt;= showPages) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Show all pages</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      for (let i = 1; i &lt;= totalPages; i++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        pages.push(i);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } else {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Always show first page</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      pages.push(1);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (page &gt; 3) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        pages.push('ellipsis');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Show pages around current page</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const start = Math.max(2, page - 1);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const end = Math.min(totalPages - 1, page + 1);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        pages.push(i);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (page &lt; totalPages - 2) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        pages.push('ellipsis');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Always show last page</span>

+  mode: CustomMode;
+&nbsp;
+  /** Whether the dialog is currently open */
+  open: boolean;
+&nbsp;

+}

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * SaveModeDialog Component
+ *
+ * Provides a form-based dialog for saving a CustomMode to the cloud with
+ * comprehensive metadata including name, description, category, tags, and
+ * visibility settings.
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * &lt;SaveModeDialog
+ *   mode={currentMode}
+ *   open={isDialogOpen}
+ *   onOpenChange={setIsDialogOpen}
+ *   onSuccess={(id) =&gt; console.log('Saved:', id)}
+ * /&gt;
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function SaveModeDialog({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  mode,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  open,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onOpenChange,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  onSuccess,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}: SaveModeDialogProps): React.ReactElement {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { saveMode, isLoading } = useSaveMode();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Initialize form with default values from the mode</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    resolver: zodResolver(saveModeFormSchema),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    defaultValues: {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      name: mode.name || '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      description: mode.description || '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      category: undefined,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      tags: '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      isPublic: false,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Reset form when dialog opens with new mode</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (open) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      form.reset({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        name: mode.name || '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: mode.description || '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        category: undefined,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        tags: '',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        isPublic: false,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [open, mode, form]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle form submission
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const onSubmit = async (values: SaveModeFormValues): Promise&lt;void&gt; =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Transform form values into CloudModeMetadata</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const metadata: CloudModeMetadata = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        name: values.name,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: values.description,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        tags: typeof values.tags === 'string' ? [] : values.tags,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        category: values.category,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        isPublic: values.isPublic,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Save mode to cloud</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const result = await saveMode({ mode, metadata });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Show success notification</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast.success('Mode Saved Successfully', {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Close dialog</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onOpenChange(false);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Trigger success callback</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (onSuccess &amp;&amp; result?.id) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onSuccess(result.id);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Error handling - show user-friendly message</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast.error('Failed to Save Mode', {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: errorMessage,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.error('Save mode error:', error);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle dialog close with unsaved changes warning
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleOpenChange = (newOpen: boolean): void =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onOpenChange(newOpen);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function formatCategory(category: string | undefined): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!category) return 'Uncategorized';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return category</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    .split('-')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    .map((word) =&gt; word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    .join(' ');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Get initials from name or email
+ *
+ * @param name - User's display name
+ * @param email - User's email address
+ * @returns Two-character initials
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function getInitials(screenName: string | undefined): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (!screenName) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return '??';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const parts = screenName.split(/[\s_-]+/);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (parts.length &gt;= 2) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return screenName.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Format star rating for display
+ *
+ * @param rating - Numeric rating value
+ * @returns Formatted rating string with one decimal place
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function formatRating(rating: number): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return rating.toFixed(1);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Format large numbers with K/M suffix
+ *
+ * @param value - Numeric value to format
+ * @returns Formatted string with K or M suffix for large numbers
+ *
+ * @example
+ * formatMetric(1234) // "1.2K"
+ * formatMetric(1234567) // "1.2M"
+ * formatMetric(42) // "42"
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function formatMetric(value: number): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (value &gt;= 1000000) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${(value / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (value &gt;= 1000) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${(value / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return value.toString();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function truncateDescription(text: string, maxLength: number = 120): string {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (text.length &lt;= maxLength) return text;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return text.slice(0, maxLength).trim() + '...';</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleCancel = () =&gt; {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const formatStorageSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return `${bytes} B`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: number | null): string =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!timestamp) return 'Never';</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - timestamp) / 1000);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (seconds &lt; 10) return 'just now';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (seconds &lt; 60) return `${seconds}s ago`;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (minutes &lt; 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (hours &lt; 24) return `${hours}h ago`;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${days}d ago`;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setTimeAgo(formatTimeAgo(lastSaved));</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const interval = setInterval(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setTimeAgo(formatTimeAgo(lastSaved));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }, 10000);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return () =&gt; clearInterval(interval);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [lastSaved]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleManualSave = async () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setIsSaving(true);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } finally {</span>

+&nbsp;

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setShowClearConfirm(true);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setTimeout(() =&gt; setShowClearConfirm(false), 3000);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 bg-muted/50 border-t text-xs"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          }`}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          title={isDirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'All changes saved'}</span>
+        /&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;span className="text-muted-foreground"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {isDirty ? 'Unsaved' : 'Saved'} {timeAgo}</span>
+        &lt;/span&gt;

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="text-muted-foreground"&gt;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="flex-1" /&gt;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onClick={handleManualSave}</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {isSaving ? (</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef&lt;</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';</span></span></span>
+import type { AuthState, User, Session } from '@/types/auth';
+import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const AuthContext = createContext&lt;AuthState | undefined&gt;(undefined);</span>
+&nbsp;
+interface AuthProviderProps {
+  children: React.ReactNode;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * AuthProvider component
+ * Manages authentication state and provides auth methods to the application
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function AuthProvider({ children }: AuthProviderProps) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;User | null&gt;(null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [session, setSession] = useState&lt;Session | null&gt;(null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Initialize session on mount</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let mounted = true;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    async function initializeSession() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        // Get initial session</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          data: { session: initialSession },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          error,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        } = await supabase.auth.getSession();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          throw error;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (mounted) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setSession(initialSession);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setUser(initialSession?.user ?? null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        console.error('Failed to initialize session:', error);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (mounted) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setSession(null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setUser(null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } finally {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (mounted) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setLoading(false);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    initializeSession();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      mounted = false;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Listen for auth state changes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      data: { subscription },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, currentSession) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setSession(currentSession);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setUser(currentSession?.user ?? null);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      subscription.unsubscribe();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Initiate Google OAuth sign-in flow
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const signInWithGoogle = async (): Promise&lt;void&gt; =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        provider: 'google',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        options: {</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" ></span></span></span>
+ * React Query hooks for cloud mode operations
+ *
+ * This module provides React Query hooks for all CloudModeService operations,
+ * including queries for fetching modes and mutations for modifying them.
+ * Implements optimistic updates, cache invalidation, and proper error handling.
+ *
+ * @module hooks/use-cloud-modes
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
+import { createCloudModeService } from '@/services/cloud-mode-service';
+import type {
+  CloudMode,
+  ModeFilters,
+  PaginatedResponse,
+} from '@/services/cloud-mode-service';
+import type { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';
+import type { CloudModeMetadata } from '@/types/cloud-mode';
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// SERVICE SINGLETON</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Singleton CloudModeService instance
+ * Uses the global Supabase client
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const cloudModeService = createCloudModeService(supabase);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// QUERY KEYS</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Centralized query key factory for cloud modes
+ *
+ * Provides consistent query keys for React Query cache management.
+ * Use these keys for all queries and cache invalidation.
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export const cloudModeKeys = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Base key for all cloud mode queries */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  all: ['cloud-modes'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Base key for all mode lists */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  lists: () =&gt; [...cloudModeKeys.all, 'list'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for a specific list with filters */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  list: (filters: ModeFilters) =&gt; [...cloudModeKeys.lists(), filters] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for user's private modes */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  myModes: () =&gt; [...cloudModeKeys.all, 'my-modes'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for public modes catalog */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  publicModes: (filters: ModeFilters) =&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    [...cloudModeKeys.all, 'public', filters] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Base key for all mode details */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  details: () =&gt; [...cloudModeKeys.all, 'detail'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for a specific mode by ID */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  detail: (id: string) =&gt; [...cloudModeKeys.details(), id] as const,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >};</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// QUERY HOOKS</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Get all modes for the current user (private library)
+ *
+ * Fetches modes authored by the current user, including both public and private modes.
+ * Requires authentication.
+ *
+ * @returns React Query result with user's modes
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function MyLibrary() {
+ *   const { data: modes, isLoading, error } = useMyModes();
+ *
+ *   if (isLoading) return &lt;Spinner /&gt;;
+ *   if (error) return &lt;Error message={error.message} /&gt;;
+ *
+ *   return &lt;ModeList modes={modes} /&gt;;
+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useMyModes() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useQuery({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryKey: cloudModeKeys.myModes(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryFn: () =&gt; cloudModeService.getMyModes(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    staleTime: 1 * 60 * 1000, // 1 minute</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    retry: 1, // Only retry once for auth errors</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Get public modes with filters and pagination
+ *
+ * Fetches publicly visible modes from the catalog with optional filtering,
+ * sorting, and pagination. Does not require authentication.
+ *
+ * @param filters - Filter, sort, and pagination options
+ * @returns React Query result with paginated public modes
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function Catalog() {
+ *   const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
+ *   const { data, isLoading } = usePublicModes({
+ *     page,

+ *
+ * Toggles the like status for the current user. Uses optimistic updates for instant
+ * feedback. Requires authentication.
+ *
+ * @returns React Query mutation for liking/unliking modes
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx

+ *   const toggleLike = useLikeMode();
+ *
+ *   const handleClick = () =&gt; {

+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useLikeMode() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const queryClient = useQueryClient();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useMutation({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    mutationFn: async ({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      modeId,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      currentlyLiked,</span>
+    }: {
+      modeId: string;
+      currentlyLiked: boolean;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (currentlyLiked) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await cloudModeService.unlikeMode(modeId);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } else {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await cloudModeService.likeMode(modeId);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onMutate: async ({ modeId, currentlyLiked }) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Cancel outgoing refetches</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: cloudModeKeys.detail(modeId) });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Snapshot previous value</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const previousMode = queryClient.getQueryData&lt;CloudMode&gt;(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        cloudModeKeys.detail(modeId)</span>
+      );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Optimistically update</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (previousMode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const optimisticMode: CloudMode = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          ...previousMode,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          likes: currentlyLiked ? previousMode.likes - 1 : previousMode.likes + 1,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          userLiked: !currentlyLiked,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        queryClient.setQueryData(cloudModeKeys.detail(modeId), optimisticMode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return { previousMode };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onError: (err, { modeId }, context) =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >import * as React from "react";</span></span></span>
+&nbsp;
+import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;</span>
+&nbsp;
+type ToasterToast = ToastProps &amp; {
+  id: string;
+  title?: React.ReactNode;
+  description?: React.ReactNode;
+  action?: ToastActionElement;
+};
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const actionTypes = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >} as const;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >let count = 0;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function genId() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return count.toString();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;
+&nbsp;
+type Action =
+  | {
+      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
+      toast: ToasterToast;
+    }
+  | {
+      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
+      toast: Partial&lt;ToasterToast&gt;;
+    }
+  | {
+      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
+      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
+    }
+  | {
+      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
+      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
+    };
+&nbsp;
+interface State {
+  toasts: ToasterToast[];
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const toastTimeouts = new Map&lt;string, ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;&gt;();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const timeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    dispatch({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toastId: toastId,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >};</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  switch (action.type) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case "ADD_TOAST":</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...state,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case "UPDATE_TOAST":</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...state,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt; (t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t)),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const { toastId } = action;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (toastId) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } else {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        state.toasts.forEach((toast) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...state,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            ? {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                ...t,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                open: false,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            : t,</span>
+        ),
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    case "REMOVE_TOAST":</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (action.toastId === undefined) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          ...state,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          toasts: [],</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...state,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) =&gt; t.id !== action.toastId),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >};</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const listeners: Array&lt;(state: State) =&gt; void&gt; = [];</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function dispatch(action: Action) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  listeners.forEach((listener) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    listener(memoryState);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+type Toast = Omit&lt;ToasterToast, "id"&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const id = genId();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    dispatch({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast: { ...props, id },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const dismiss = () =&gt; dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  dispatch({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    type: "ADD_TOAST",</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    toast: {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      ...props,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      open: true,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      onOpenChange: (open) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (!open) dismiss();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    id: id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    dismiss,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    update,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >function useToast() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [state, setState] = React.useState&lt;State&gt;(memoryState);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
