+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >/**</span></span></span>
+ * React Query hooks for user profile operations
+ *
+ * Provides hooks for fetching and updating user profiles, including screen name
+ * selection. Implements optimistic updates, cache management, and error handling.
+ *
+ * @module hooks/use-user-profile
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
+import { createUserProfileService } from '@/services/user-profile-service';
+import type { UserProfile } from '@/services/user-profile-service';
+import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// SERVICE SINGLETON</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Singleton UserProfileService instance
+ * Uses the global Supabase client
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const userProfileService = createUserProfileService(supabase);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// QUERY KEYS</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Centralized query key factory for user profile
+ *
+ * Provides consistent query keys for React Query cache management.
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export const userProfileKeys = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Base key for all user profile queries */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  all: ['userProfile'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for current user's profile */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  profile: () =&gt; [...userProfileKeys.all, 'current'] as const,</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /** Key for screen name options with count */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  screenNameOptions: (count: number) =&gt; [...userProfileKeys.all, 'screenNameOptions', count] as const,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >};</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// QUERY HOOKS</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Hook to fetch current user profile
+ *
+ * Fetches the authenticated user's profile including screen name and avatar.
+ * Requires authentication.
+ *
+ * @returns React Query result with user profile
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function ProfilePage() {
+ *   const { data: profile, isLoading, error } = useUserProfile();
+ *
+ *   if (isLoading) return &lt;ProfileSkeleton /&gt;;
+ *   if (error) return &lt;ProfileError error={error} /&gt;;
+ *
+ *   return &lt;ProfileHeader profile={profile} /&gt;;
+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useUserProfile() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useQuery({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryKey: userProfileKeys.profile(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryFn: () =&gt; userProfileService.getUserProfile(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes (formerly cacheTime)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    retry: 1, // Only retry once for auth errors</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Hook to generate screen name options
+ *
+ * Generates a batch of unique screen name options for user selection.
+ * Does not cache results (always fetches fresh names).
+ *
+ * @param count Number of options to generate (default: 10)
+ * @returns React Query result with screen name array
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function ScreenNamePicker() {
+ *   const { data: options, isLoading, refetch } = useGenerateScreenNames(10);
+ *
+ *   const handleRegenerate = () =&gt; {
+ *     refetch();
+ *   };
+ *
+ *   return (
+ *     &lt;&gt;
+ *       {options?.map(name =&gt; &lt;NameOption key={name} name={name} /&gt;)}
+ *       &lt;Button onClick={handleRegenerate}&gt;Regenerate&lt;/Button&gt;
+ *     &lt;/&gt;
+ *   );
+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useGenerateScreenNames(count: number = 10) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useQuery({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryKey: userProfileKeys.screenNameOptions(count),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    queryFn: () =&gt; userProfileService.generateScreenNameOptions(count),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    staleTime: 0, // Always fetch fresh names</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    gcTime: 0, // Don't cache</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// MUTATION HOOKS</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >// ============================================================================</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Hook to update user's screen name with optimistic updates
+ *
+ * Updates the user's screen name with immediate UI feedback via optimistic updates.
+ * Automatically rolls back on error and shows toast notifications.
+ *
+ * @returns React Query mutation for updating screen name
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function ScreenNameSection({ profile }) {
+ *   const [selected, setSelected] = useState&lt;string&gt;();
+ *   const updateScreenName = useUpdateScreenName();
+ *
+ *   const handleSave = () =&gt; {
+ *     if (selected) {
+ *       updateScreenName.mutate(selected);
+ *     }
+ *   };
+ *
+ *   return (
+ *     &lt;&gt;
+ *       &lt;ScreenNamePicker onSelect={setSelected} /&gt;
+ *       &lt;Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={updateScreenName.isPending}&gt;
+ *         Save
+ *       &lt;/Button&gt;
+ *     &lt;/&gt;
+ *   );
+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useUpdateScreenName() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const queryClient = useQueryClient();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useMutation({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    mutationFn: (newScreenName: string) =&gt; userProfileService.updateScreenName(newScreenName),</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Optimistic update</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onMutate: async (newScreenName: string) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Cancel outgoing refetches</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: userProfileKeys.profile() });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Snapshot previous value</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const previousProfile = queryClient.getQueryData&lt;UserProfile&gt;(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        userProfileKeys.profile()</span>
+      );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Optimistically update</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (previousProfile) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        queryClient.setQueryData&lt;UserProfile&gt;(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          userProfileKeys.profile(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            ...previousProfile,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            screenName: newScreenName,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          }</span>
+        );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return { previousProfile };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Rollback on error</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onError: (error, newScreenName, context) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (context?.previousProfile) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        queryClient.setQueryData(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          userProfileKeys.profile(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          context.previousProfile</span>
+        );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        title: 'Failed to Update Screen Name',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        variant: 'destructive',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Success</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onSuccess: (updatedProfile) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      queryClient.setQueryData(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        userProfileKeys.profile(),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        updatedProfile</span>
+      );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      toast({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        title: 'Screen Name Updated',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        description: `Your screen name is now "${updatedProfile.screenName}"`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Always refetch after error or success</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    onSettled: () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: userProfileKeys.profile() });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * Hook to validate screen name availability
+ *
+ * Checks if a screen name is available without updating the profile.
+ * Useful for real-time validation.
+ *
+ * @returns React Query mutation for validation
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```tsx
+ * function ScreenNameValidator({ name }) {
+ *   const validateName = useValidateScreenName();
+ *
+ *   const handleCheck = async () =&gt; {
+ *     const isAvailable = await validateName.mutateAsync(name);
+ *     console.log(`${name} is ${isAvailable ? 'available' : 'taken'}`);
+ *   };
+ *
+ *   return &lt;Button onClick={handleCheck}&gt;Check Availability&lt;/Button&gt;;
+ * }
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useValidateScreenName() {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return useMutation({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    mutationFn: (screenName: string) =&gt; userProfileService.validateScreenNameAvailable(screenName),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >class WebMidiBackend implements MidiBackendInterface {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async initialize(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (this.isInitialized) return;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Check if Web MIDI API is available</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.requestMIDIAccess) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Web MIDI API not available. Requires modern browser with MIDI support and HTTPS.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Request MIDI access with SysEx permission (required for custom modes)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      this.midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: true });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Set up connection state change handler</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      this.midiAccess.onstatechange = (event) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (event.port) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          console.debug('[WebMidiBackend] MIDI port state changed:', event.port.name, event.port.state);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      this.isInitialized = true;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.log('[WebMidiBackend] Web MIDI API initialized successfully');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error: any) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error.name === 'SecurityError') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error('MIDI access denied. Web MIDI requires user permission and HTTPS in production.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } else if (error.name === 'NotSupportedError') {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error('Web MIDI API not supported in this browser.');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      } else {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error(`Failed to initialize Web MIDI API: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async getInputPorts(): Promise&lt;MidiPortInfo[]&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!this.isInitialized || !this.midiAccess) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Backend not initialized');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const ports: MidiPortInfo[] = [];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.midiAccess.inputs.forEach((port, id) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      ports.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        name: port.name || `Input ${id}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...(port.manufacturer &amp;&amp; { manufacturer: port.manufacturer }),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...(port.version &amp;&amp; { version: port.version })</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return ports;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async getOutputPorts(): Promise&lt;MidiPortInfo[]&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!this.isInitialized || !this.midiAccess) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Backend not initialized');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const ports: MidiPortInfo[] = [];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.midiAccess.outputs.forEach((port, id) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      ports.push({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        id,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        name: port.name || `Output ${id}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...(port.manufacturer &amp;&amp; { manufacturer: port.manufacturer }),</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ...(port.version &amp;&amp; { version: port.version })</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return ports;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async openInput(portId: string): Promise&lt;MidiInputPort&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!this.isInitialized || !this.midiAccess) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error('Backend not initialized');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let midiInput: MIDIInput | undefined;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.midiAccess.inputs.forEach((input, id) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (id === portId) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        midiInput = input;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!midiInput) {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await midiInput.open();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const port: MidiInputPort = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        id: portId,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        name: midiInput.name || `Input ${portId}`,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        type: 'input',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        close: async () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          await midiInput!.close();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          this.openInputs.delete(portId);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onMessage: undefined</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      // Set up message handler</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      midiInput.onmidimessage = (event: any) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (port.onMessage) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          const data: number[] = Array.from(event.data as Uint8Array);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          port.onMessage({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            timestamp: event.timeStamp,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            data</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      this.openInputs.set(portId, midiInput);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return port;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error: any) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to open input port ${portId}: ${error.message}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async openOutput(portId: string): Promise&lt;MidiOutputPort&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!this.isInitialized || !this.midiAccess) {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let midiOutput: MIDIOutput | undefined;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        midiOutput = output;</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!midiOutput) {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await midiOutput.open();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const port: MidiOutputPort = {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        id: portId,</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        type: 'output',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        close: async () =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      this.openOutputs.set(portId, midiOutput);</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async sendMessage(port: MidiOutputPort, message: MidiMessage): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const midiOutput = this.openOutputs.get(port.id);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!midiOutput) {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async closePort(port: MidiPort): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await midiInput.close();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        this.openInputs.delete(port.id);</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await midiOutput.close();</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async cleanup(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setMidiBackend(backend);</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        // Step 2: Create LaunchControlXL3 instance with initialized backend</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        console.log('[useLCXL3Device] Creating LaunchControlXL3 instance with MIDI backend...');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const deviceInstance = new LaunchControlXL3({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          midiBackend: backend,</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setState(prev =&gt; ({ ...prev, device: deviceInstance, isConnected: true }));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const handleReady = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          console.log('[useLCXL3Device] Device ready event');</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          setState(prev =&gt; ({ ...prev, device: deviceInstance, isConnected: true }));</span>

+import { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';
+import { LocalStorageManager } from '@/lib/storage/local-storage';
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2000;</span>
+&nbsp;
+interface UseLocalStorageOptions {
+  autoSave: boolean;
+  onLoadSuccess?: (mode: CustomMode) =&gt; void;
+  onLoadError?: (error: Error) =&gt; void;
+  onSaveSuccess?: () =&gt; void;
+  onSaveError?: (error: Error) =&gt; void;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export function useLocalStorage(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  mode: CustomMode,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  isDirty: boolean,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  options: UseLocalStorageOptions</span>
+) {
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const storageManager = useRef(new LocalStorageManager());</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const saveTimeoutRef = useRef&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt; | undefined&gt;(undefined);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const lastSavedRef = useRef&lt;string&gt;('');</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const saveToStorage = useCallback(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const modeJson = JSON.stringify(mode);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (modeJson === lastSavedRef.current) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      storageManager.current.save(mode);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      lastSavedRef.current = modeJson;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      options.onSaveSuccess?.();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      options.onSaveError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Failed to save'));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [mode, options]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const loadFromStorage = useCallback(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const loaded = storageManager.current.load();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (loaded) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        lastSavedRef.current = JSON.stringify(loaded);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        options.onLoadSuccess?.(loaded);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } catch (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      options.onLoadError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Failed to load'));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [options]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const clearStorage = useCallback(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    storageManager.current.clear();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    lastSavedRef.current = '';</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const getSavedAt = useCallback(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return storageManager.current.getSavedAt();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const getStorageSize = useCallback(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return storageManager.current.getStorageSize();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    loadFromStorage();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [loadFromStorage]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!options.autoSave || !isDirty) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      saveToStorage();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }, AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, [mode, isDirty, options.autoSave, saveToStorage]);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    saveToStorage,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    loadFromStorage,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    clearStorage,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    getSavedAt,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    getStorageSize,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >}</span></pre></td></tr></table></pre>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          ['SEND_B1', 'SEND_B2', 'SEND_B3', 'SEND_B4', 'SEND_B5', 'SEND_B6', 'SEND_B7', 'SEND_B8'],</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        ];</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return knobLabels[row - 1]?.[col - 1] || control.id;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } else if (control.type === 'fader') {</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return control.id;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const updateControl = useCallback((control: Control, updates: Partial&lt;ControlMapping&gt;) =&gt; {</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setIsDirty(true);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }, []);</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const getControlMapping = useCallback((control: Control): ControlMapping | null =&gt; {</span>

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" ></span></span></span>
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * HTTP request options
+ */
+export interface RequestOptions extends RequestInit {
+  /**
+   * Request timeout in milliseconds
+   * @default 30000 (30 seconds)
+   */
+  timeout?: number;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Whether to automatically inject authentication token
+   * @default true
+   */
+  includeAuth?: boolean;
+}
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**</span>
+ * API Client for making authenticated HTTP requests to Netlify Functions
+ *
+ * IMPORTANT: This client is specifically for custom Netlify Functions, NOT for Supabase.
+ *
+ * Architecture Overview:
+ * - Authentication is 100% Supabase-direct (client-side auth)
+ * - This client is ONLY for Netlify Functions that need:
+ *   - API secrets (e.g., third-party API keys)
+ *   - Server-side processing (heavy computation, file processing)
+ *   - Webhooks and external integrations
+ *   - Custom business logic that can't run client-side
+ *
+ * Deployment Configuration:
+ * - Production: Functions deployed at `/.netlify/functions/*`
+ * - Local Dev: Use `netlify dev` and set VITE_API_BASE_URL if needed
+ * - Override: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL environment variable
+ *
+ * Features:
+ * - Automatic Supabase access token injection
+ * - Token refresh on 401 responses
+ * - Configurable request timeouts
+ * - Full TypeScript type safety
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * // Call a Netlify Function at /.netlify/functions/process-audio
+ * const result = await apiClient.post('/process-audio', {
+ *   fileUrl: 'https://...',
+ *   options: { format: 'wav' }
+ * });
+ * ```
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export class ApiClient {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private baseUrl: string;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private defaultTimeout: number;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  constructor(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    baseUrl: string = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/.netlify/functions',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    defaultTimeout: number = 30000</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  ) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    this.defaultTimeout = defaultTimeout;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Get current access token from Supabase session
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  private async getAccessToken(): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      data: { session },</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    } = await supabase.auth.getSession();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return session?.access_token ?? null;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Refresh the current session and return new access token
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { PackageOpen } from "lucide-react";</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { usePublicModes } from "@/hooks/use-cloud-modes";</span>
+import { ModeFilters } from "@/types/cloud-mode";
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { ModeFiltersPanel } from "@/components/cloud-storage/ModeFiltersPanel";</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { ModeBrowserLayout } from "@/components/cloud-storage/ModeBrowserLayout";</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { ModeGrid } from "@/components/cloud-storage/ModeGrid";</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const Catalog = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const navigate = useNavigate();</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Filter state</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const [filters, setFilters] = useState&lt;ModeFilters&gt;({</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    sort: 'recent',</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    limit: 24,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    page: 1,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  });</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Fetch public modes</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { data, isLoading, error } = usePublicModes(filters);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle page navigation
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handlePageChange = (newPage: number) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setFilters((prev) =&gt; ({ ...prev, page: newPage }));</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle mode selection (navigate to detail view)
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleModeSelect = (mode: any) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    navigate(`/modes/${mode.id}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Handle mode load (apply to editor)
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleModeLoad = (mode: any) =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    navigate(`/?mode=${mode.id}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Custom empty state message</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const emptyMessage = filters.search || filters.category || filters.tags</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    ? "Try adjusting your filters to find more modes."</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    : "Be the first to share a mode with the community!";</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Prepare pagination data for ModeGrid</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const paginationData = data?.pagination ? {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    page: data.pagination.page,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    totalPages: data.pagination.totalPages,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    hasNext: data.pagination.hasNext,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    hasPrev: data.pagination.hasPrev,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    total: data.pagination.total,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    limit: data.pagination.limit,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  } : undefined;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;ModeBrowserLayout</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      title="Community Catalog"</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      subtitle="Discover and share custom modes with the community"</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      filters={</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;ModeFiltersPanel</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          variant="catalog"</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          filters={filters}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          onChange={setFilters}</span>
+        /&gt;
+      }
+    &gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;ModeGrid</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        modes={data?.data || []}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        isLoading={isLoading}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error={error}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        emptyMessage={emptyMessage}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        emptyIcon={&lt;PackageOpen className="h-24 w-24 text-muted-foreground/50" /&gt;}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onModeSelect={handleModeSelect}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onModeLoad={handleModeLoad}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        showPagination={true}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        pagination={paginationData}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onPageChange={handlePageChange}</span>
+      /&gt;
+    &lt;/ModeBrowserLayout&gt;
+  );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >};</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >export default Catalog;</span></pre></td></tr></table></pre>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let result = [...modes];</span>
+&nbsp;

+&nbsp;

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const matchesName = mode.name.toLowerCase().includes(query);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const matchesDescription = mode.description?.toLowerCase().includes(query);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        const matchesTags = mode.tags?.some((tag) =&gt; tag.toLowerCase().includes(query));</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return matchesName || matchesDescription || matchesTags || matchesCategory;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      });</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Apply sorting</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          return new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        case "oldest":</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      }</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";</span>
+import {

+  Edit,

+  Calendar,
+  User,
+  Tag,
+  AlertCircle,
+  Play,

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { motion } from "framer-motion";</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { useModeById } from "@/hooks/use-cloud-modes";</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >const ModeDetail = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { id } = useParams&lt;{ id: string }&gt;();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const navigate = useNavigate();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const { data: mode, isLoading, error } = useModeById(id || "");</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Handle loading into editor</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleLoad = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigate(`/?mode=${mode.id}`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Handle editing</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  const handleEdit = () =&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigate(`/?mode=${mode.id}&amp;edit=true`);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  };</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Loading state</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (isLoading) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 space-y-8"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;Skeleton className="h-10 w-32" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div className="space-y-4"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-12 w-3/4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Skeleton className="h-32 w-full" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex gap-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-6 w-24" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Skeleton className="h-6 w-24" /&gt;</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  // Error state</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (error || !mode) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;AlertCircle className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 text-destructive" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2"&gt;Mode Not Found&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;p className="text-muted-foreground mb-6"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          {error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The requested mode could not be found"}</span>
+        &lt;/p&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;Button onClick={() =&gt; navigate("/library")} variant="outline"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+          Back to Library
+        &lt;/Button&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    );
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    &lt;div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 space-y-8"&gt;</span>
+      {/* Back button */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;Button</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        variant="ghost"</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        onClick={() =&gt; navigate("/library")}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        className="mb-4"</span>
+      &gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+        Back to Library
+      &lt;/Button&gt;
+&nbsp;
+      {/* Mode header */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      &lt;motion.div</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        className="space-y-4"</span>
+      &gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;h1 className="text-4xl font-bold bg-gradient-primary bg-clip-text text-transparent mb-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              {mode.name}</span>
+            &lt;/h1&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                &lt;User className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                {mode.author?.screenName || "Unknown Author"}</span>
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                &lt;Calendar className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(mode.createdAt), { addSuffix: true })}</span>
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+&nbsp;
+          {/* Action buttons */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Button onClick={handleLoad} className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              &lt;Play className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+              Load
+            &lt;/Button&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Button onClick={handleEdit} variant="outline"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              &lt;Edit className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt;</span>
+              Edit
+            &lt;/Button&gt;
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+&nbsp;
+        {/* Stats */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-6 text-sm"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Heart className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            {mode.likes}</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Download className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            {mode.downloads}</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Eye className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            {mode.views}</span>
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+&nbsp;
+        {/* Category */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {mode.category &amp;&amp; (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;Badge variant="secondary" className="capitalize"&gt;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            {mode.category.replace("-", " ")}</span>
+          &lt;/Badge&gt;

+&nbsp;
+        {/* Description */}
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        {mode.description &amp;&amp; (</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          &lt;div className="prose prose-sm max-w-none"&gt;</span>

+&nbsp;

+<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js"><span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/**<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" ></span></span></span>
+ * CloudModeService - Interface-first service for cloud mode operations
+ *
+ * This service handles all CRUD operations and engagement features for cloud-stored
+ * MIDI controller modes. Uses dependency injection for the Supabase client.
+ *
+ * @module services/cloud-mode-service
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" > */</span>
+&nbsp;
+import { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
+import type { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';
+&nbsp;
+// ============================================================================
+// Type Definitions
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Pagination options for browsing modes
+ */
+export interface PaginationOptions {
+  page?: number;
+  limit?: number;
+  sort?: 'recent' | 'downloads' | 'likes' | 'rating';
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Filter options for browsing modes
+ */
+export interface ModeFilters extends PaginationOptions {
+  category?: string;
+  tags?: string[];
+  authorId?: string;
+  isPublic?: boolean;
+  isFeatured?: boolean;
+  search?: string;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Cloud-stored mode with full metadata
+ */
+export interface CloudMode extends CustomMode {
+  // Unique identification
+  id: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Ownership
+  authorId: string;
+  author?: {
+    id: string;
+    email: string;
+    displayName: string;
+    avatarUrl?: string;
+  };
+&nbsp;
+  // Visibility
+  isPublic: boolean;
+  isOfficial: boolean;
+  isFeatured: boolean;
+&nbsp;
+  // Engagement (denormalized)
+  downloads: number;
+  likes: number;
+  views: number;
+  rating: number;
+  ratingCount: number;
+  forkCount: number;
+&nbsp;
+  // Discovery
+  tags: string[];
+  category?: string;
+  thumbnail?: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Relationships
+  parentModeId?: string;
+  parentMode?: CloudMode;
+&nbsp;
+  // Timestamps
+  publishedAt?: string;
+  updatedAt: string;
+&nbsp;
+  // Client-side computed
+  userLiked?: boolean;
+  userRating?: number;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Paginated response wrapper
+ */
+export interface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; {
+  data: T[];
+  pagination: {
+    page: number;
+    limit: number;
+    total: number;
+    totalPages: number;
+    hasNext: boolean;
+    hasPrev: boolean;
+  };
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Database row type (snake_case from PostgreSQL)
+ */
+interface ModeRow {
+  id: string;
+  author_id: string;
+  name: string;
+  description: string | null;
+  version: string;
+  controls: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+  is_public: boolean;
+  is_official: boolean;
+  is_featured: boolean;
+  downloads: number;
+  likes: number;
+  views: number;
+  fork_count: number;
+  rating: number | null;
+  rating_count: number;
+  tags: string[];
+  category: string | null;
+  thumbnail: string | null;
+  parent_mode_id: string | null;
+  created_at: string;
+  modified_at: string;
+  published_at: string | null;
+}
+&nbsp;
+/**

+ */
+interface ModeInsert {
+  id?: string;
+  author_id: string;
+  name: string;
+  description?: string | null;
+  version?: string;
+  controls: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+  is_public?: boolean;

+  is_featured?: boolean;
+  tags?: string[];

+}
+&nbsp;
+/**

+interface ModeUpdate {

+}

+// ============================================================================
+// Service Interface
+// ============================================================================
+&nbsp;
+/**
+ * Interface for cloud mode operations
+ */
+export interface ICloudModeService {
+  /**
+   * Save a custom mode to the cloud
+   */
+  saveMode(mode: CustomMode): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get all modes for the current user
+   */
+  getMyModes(): Promise&lt;CloudMode[]&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get a specific mode by ID
+   */
+  getModeById(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode | null&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Update an existing mode
+   */
+  updateMode(id: string, updates: Partial&lt;CloudMode&gt;): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Delete a mode
+   */
+  deleteMode(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Publish a mode (make it public)
+   */
+  publishMode(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Unpublish a mode (make it private)
+   */
+  unpublishMode(id: string): Promise&lt;CloudMode&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Get public modes with pagination and filters
+   */
+  getPublicModes(options: ModeFilters): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;CloudMode&gt;&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Like a mode (toggle)
+   */
+  likeMode(modeId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Unlike a mode (toggle)
+   */
+  unlikeMode(modeId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+&nbsp;
+  /**
+   * Rate a mode with optional review
+   */
+  rateMode(modeId: string, rating: number, review?: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
+}

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      views: row.views,</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      rating: row.rating || 0,</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  /**</span>
+   * Get public modes with pagination and filters
+   *
+   * @param options - Filter and pagination options
+   * @returns Paginated response with cloud modes
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >   */</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async getPublicModes(</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    options: ModeFilters = {}</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;CloudMode&gt;&gt; {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { page = 1, limit = 20, sort = 'recent', showLikedOnly } = options;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let query = this.supabase</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .from('modes')</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .select('*', { count: 'exact' })</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      .eq('is_public', true);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Apply sorting</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    switch (sort) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'downloads':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('downloads', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'likes':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('likes', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'rating':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('rating', { ascending: false, nullsLast: true });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        break;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      case 'recent':</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      default:</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        query = query.order('created_at', { ascending: false });</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    }</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Apply pagination</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const from = (page - 1) * limit;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const to = from + limit - 1;</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    query = query.range(from, to);</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data: modesData, error, count } = await query;</span>
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (error) {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch public modes: ${error.message}`);</span>

+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const total = count || 0;</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    const { data: profilesData } = await this.supabase</span>

+    );
+&nbsp;
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    // Fetch current user's likes for these modes (if authenticated)</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    let likedModeIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const userId = await this.getCurrentUserId();</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const modeIds = (modesData || []).map(mode =&gt; mode.id);</span>
+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const { data: likesData } = await this.supabase</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      const profile = profilesMap.get(row.author_id);</span>

+<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  async likeMode(modeId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span>
